en.title: Less motion, touch targets a finger can hit, and words in each language
en.body: For the quality checklist of the games repository, where every game failed the same three items. `@egret/engine/web/kit` gives `prefersReducedMotion()`, `watchReducedMotion()` and `browserLanguages()`. A 2D camera has `shakeScale`, 0 for a still view. `play` follows the system's reduced-motion setting by default: no shakes and faint flashes, and `game.reducedMotion` can change it. A browser game gives `unitsPerCssPixel` and `padHitArea(node, 44)`, a hit area a finger can hit whatever the canvas's scale. `@egret/engine/kit` has `createTextTable`, a game's words in each language with a fallback, listeners for a change of language and a list of what each language is missing, and `pickLanguage` to start in the browser's language. `guide/entries.json`, written by `tools/entry-map.mjs`, lists the engine entries each entry brings with it, so the capability matrix can credit `web/pointer` to a game that imports `web/game`.

zh.title: 减少动态效果、手指能按到的触控区、各语言的文字
zh.body: 针对游戏仓库的品质验收清单：每款游戏都在同样的三项上不达标。`@egret/engine/web/kit` 提供 `prefersReducedMotion()`、`watchReducedMotion()` 和 `browserLanguages()`。2D 相机有 `shakeScale`，设为 0 画面就不晃。`play` 默认跟随系统的"减少动态效果"设置：不晃动、闪光变淡，可通过 `game.reducedMotion` 修改。浏览器游戏提供 `unitsPerCssPixel` 和 `padHitArea(node, 44)`，无论画布缩放多少，点击区都够手指按。`@egret/engine/kit` 新增 `createTextTable`：游戏各语言的文字，带回退语言、语言切换监听和每种语言缺失键的列表；`pickLanguage` 按浏览器语言开始。新增由 `tools/entry-map.mjs` 生成的 `guide/entries.json`，列出每个引擎入口带上的其他入口，能力覆盖矩阵可以据此把 `web/pointer` 等算到导入了 `web/game` 的游戏名下。
